# employment compensation

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:employmentCompensation`](gmeow-employmentCompensation.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/employmentCompensation>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/employment`](../../slices/employment.md)

The monetary compensation of an employment, expressed as a [`MonetaryAmount`](../classes/gmeow-MonetaryAmount.md) with explicit currency frame ([Principle 11](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-11)). Non-functional: a single employment may have several compensation figures over time (raises, bonuses, multi-currency arrangements), recorded as co-equal standpoint-indexed claims.

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Employment`](../classes/gmeow-Employment.md) -> [`gmeow:MonetaryAmount`](../classes/gmeow-MonetaryAmount.md)
